title: Hot Pursuit Charter Fishing LLC
specs: 46' x 14' boat with upper deck and private bathroom
Captain Don has 40+ years Chesapeake Bay fishing experience
Smoking allowed only in outdoor spaces on vessel
Boat certified for 32 passengers; recommended group size 8-12 for fishing trips
Only one group per trip; customers organize their own group
blurb: Guests board the Hot Pursuit boat and fish for rockfish and other species in Chesapeake Bay. The captain selects fishing locations and methods based on season and conditions. Trips include fishing, coaching, and a ride back to dock with catch cleanup handled by the crew.
extraNote: Cancellations made 14 days in advance receive 100% refund minus processing fee · Cancellations within 14 days are non-refundable unless canceled by captain due to weather · $200 deposit reserves trip; balance due later · Customary 20% mate's tip is expected, paid day of trip · Minimum base fare applies for up to 6 guests; $90 per additional guest over 6 · Anchor Yacht Basin, 1048 Turkey Point Rd, Edgewater, MD or Geisler Point Marina, 7831 SW Rd, Pasadena, MD 21122; confirm with Captain Don prior to charter · April through December 5, with specific fishing seasons May 1 – July 31, August closed for rockfish, Sept 1 – Dec 5 open
